subject: Welcome — Redwood demo & scheduling
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@fintegrate.io>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome — Redwood demo & scheduling

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! I’m Monica on the growth team — congrats on getting set up. We automatically queue a short technical demo to help teams validate integration and performance. To make scheduling quick, pick a 30-minute slot that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo?slot=30m&token=9f4a2b

Suggested agenda (attached):
- Quick intros (5 min)
- Overview of integration flow and runtime latency expectations (10 min)
- Walk through a short proof-of-concept prompt + embeddings example (10 min)
- Next steps & rollout options (5 min)

If you prefer, I’ve looped in our AE, Sergio Alvarez (sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai), who can help coordinate a time that fits your team and include an engineer. Reply here with any constraints (time zone, required attendees) and we’ll lock it in.

Attachment: Quick-Demo-Agenda.pdf (1 page) — one-pager agenda and sample questions

Best,
Monica Patel
Growth — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

---
This is an automated scheduling template sent by the Growth team. If you already booked via the link, please ignore this email.
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@fintegrate.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — Redwood demo & scheduling

Hi Monica —

Thanks — I clicked the link but want to sync with our lead engineer (we’re in ET). Are there any morning ET slots next week around 9:30–10:00am ET? If not, I can share a couple of times. Also our SRE wants a short look at network footprint and SOC 2 controls — can we have someone on the call who can speak to that?

We’re evaluating Redwood for inference on retrieval-augmented generation across a multi-tenant product.

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Product Lead, Fintegrate
jordan.miles@fintegrate.io
